notes.title: MEGA MAGICAL PATCH IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey guys! We are happy to announce that the Mega Magical Patch has arrived! It brings A LOT of fixes to Mago (some big, some small), and also mini games! Go check them out on the mini game shack in town. Also, Mago is now on a 50% Discount sale! We also wanted to announce that Mago has been selected in the “Best LATAM Game” category on the BIG Festival (The biggest Indie Video Game Festival of LATAM region). Below you will find a more detailed changelog:

-	Mini Games are now available in town.
-	You can now rematch with the main bosses on the mini game Shack once you beat them.
-	A Plethora of new sound effects have been added.
-	Save files should not get corrupted anymore (please, if you keep experiencing any problems write us at contact@dreampotiongames.com so we can fix it ASAP).
-	There is a new song in the game. Can you find it?
-	Capitower has been rebalanced to make it more enjoyable. 
-	You can now check your progress on each CapiTower thanks to the roulette on the tower lobby.
-	A LOT of bug fixes.
-	And many, many more things!

If you haven't entered the magical world of Mago yet, now is the perfect time! We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Emergency update!
notes.content:
it seems some crashes managed to make their way out into the last mago s update, but dont worry anymore! this current patch should handle them!
we apologize for the inconvenience and hope you still give our game a chance!

with love,
Dream Potion Games

notes.title: New 1.2 Update + HypeTrain Digital Publisher Sale
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

We hope you’ve all been doing great, as we’ve got some great news for you today.

First of all, our publisher HypeTrain Digital is holding a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/hypetrainpublishersale]mega publisher sale[/url], September 8-12. Apart from the biggest discounts of up to 90%, it features new game reveals, free demos, and even 3 brand new releases, also on sale – definitely worth checking out. And if for some reason you still don’t own Mago, now is the best time to fix it – the game is 30% off after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35358714/0ab04c7f66bf9f17af024d741746ac39d09c66bc.jpg[/img]

Second, and perhaps most important, we’ve just released a fresh game update with achievements, costumes and a lot of super helpful fixes – find the full change log below.

[b]What’s new[/b]: 
- Achievements are now live! Can you get them all?
 - 4 New free costumes hidden on the stages! 
- Menu Optimization: The save/load menu now shows all collectibles in game.
 - Nosey and collectable list: There is now a list that shows what noseys and collectibles are missing on each stage.
- All missing noseys are visible when you find one on the levels. 
- Configuration Menu has been revamped. 
- Updated localization (Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanesse)
 - It is now possible to skip the Boss cutscenes
 - It is now possible to skip the intro on the Dark Mago levels 
- A plethora of new sound effects have been added 
- Updated visual effects for some bosses and cutscenes 
- Updated hitboxes for purple enemies 
- Updated world map (some levels have changed location)
 - Updated cameras on all levels. 

[b]Game optimization[/b]: 
- World 6 hadd lag issues on some low resources PC's. It has been optimized. 
- World 7 had lag issues on some low resources PC's. It has been optimized. 
- Resolution Issue Fixed

[b]Fixed bugs[/b]: 
- Final boss phase 2 bug fixed. 
- Final boss phase 3 bug fixed. 
- Dragon boss crash bug fixed. 
- If you have corrupted save data the game will remove it automatically.

Let us know if you encounter any issues in the comments below this post – this will be a huge help!

We hope you enjoy the updated game experience as well as the publisher discounts, and, of course, have a great day :)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1098280/Mago/
